title: Hearing on the city's runaway and homeless youth shelter system
summary: The Council's Committee on Children and Youth held an oversight hearing on September 16, 2026 examining whether New York City's shelter system for runaway and homeless youth is meeting demand. Testimony was expected from the Department of Youth and Community Development, contracted providers and advocates on bed capacity, funding rates and outcomes. Documents note 319 youth could not access a shelter bed between January and June 2026, and that contracts covering drop-in centers, crisis shelters and transitional living programs have been repeatedly extended without a new competitive procurement since 2017.
